queries.label: structural search (syntax-aware)
queries.capability: patterntype:structural -- matches code SHAPE, not text
queries.why_not_grep: Structural search matches the syntactic shape regardless of whitespace, the exception type, or intervening comments. A regex for this is either unreadable or wrong.

queries.label: call-site navigation
queries.why_not_grep: Scoped to one repo and one language by the index, so results are not polluted by unrelated languages or vendored copies.

queries.label: cross-repository pattern search
queries.capability: repo-unscoped search across ALL indexed public repos
queries.why_not_grep: THE capability our local retriever fundamentally cannot provide: searching code we have not cloned. Finds a risky pattern across the whole public corpus.

queries.label: diff/history search
queries.capability: type:diff -- searches commit history, not the working tree
queries.why_not_grep: Searches what CHANGED over history. grep sees only the current checkout, so a pattern added and later removed is invisible to it.
